pairs.subject: model-routing
pairs.evidence: lib/text/providers/google.ts:204 The Google adapter can discard additionalProperties constraints without marking translation loss, so a request can succeed with weaker enforcement than its reported native schema contract.

techniques.evidence: lib/text/providers/google.ts:204 additionalProperties is discarded without setting lost, allowing native enforcement to be reported after a caller constraint was removed.
lib/text/providers/google.ts:292 Requests are independent headless calls; the inspected request and transport contracts do not resume a continuing conversation.
lib/text/router.ts:95 Candidates follow fixed posture tables and consumer preferences, without measurement-based scores carrying windows and sample sizes.

lib/text/providers/google.ts:56 The claimed floor is justified by downstream consequences and assigned by turn class; the recorded live checks establish reachability and schema support rather than observed below-floor workload breakage.
lib/text/providers/google.ts:118 Model override state is read inside the adapter, globally affecting consumers without consumer scope, attribution or a removal condition.
lib/claudeCli.ts:280 The shared CLI transport fixes every reasoning request at high effort instead of accepting a measured class-specific tier-and-effort pair.
lib/text/router.ts:441 Schema failures become bad-response, which is deliberately non-reroutable, so unusable structured answers stop the chain while the buffered response still permits substitution.

lib/text/log.ts:197 The final log, optional LightTrack event and spend record omit policy version, deciding rule and selected effort, preventing reconstruction of the required routing decision.
lib/text/stats.ts:53 These are operational duration and spend statistics; outcomes do not feed a candidate quality score or semantic ranking.
lib/text/router.ts:237 Policy resolution supplies a provider list without a governing rule chain, rule ownership or edit-time validation of configured model identifiers.
lib/text/providers/google.ts:113 A required closed TurnClass exists, but its model mapping returns only a string; tier and effort do not travel together through the routing contract.

pairs.subject: model-routing
pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/providers/ollama.ts:120 Ollama can return an empty recognition as success when no schema was requested, preventing the router from treating that unusable answer as a substitution signal.

techniques.evidence: lib/imaging/providers/agy.ts:221 The preferred development generator forwards prompt and aspect but silently drops the common request's negativePrompt constraint.
lib/imaging/providers/ollama.ts:96 Recognition sends an independent instruction and image rather than resuming a shared conversation whose incumbent cache must be preserved.
lib/imaging/router.ts:102 Recognition order is fixed by deployment posture; live latency, reliability, quota headroom and their measurement predicates do not determine ordering.

lib/imaging/providers/google.ts:48 The documented Lite model lacks style references but remains an unrestricted override while the adapter always advertises supportsReferences, so the style-reference requirement does not constrain model selection.
lib/imaging/providers/google.ts:49 The adapter reads a global model override internally instead of receiving an attributable consumer-scoped override.
lib/imaging/providers/ollama.ts:106 Thinking is hardcoded off and then omitted on the fallback request after any ImagingError; no calibrated class-and-effort contract governs that change.
lib/imaging/providers/ollama.ts:120 Without a requested schema, empty content reaches the successful return and is booked as served instead of triggering pre-delivery recovery.

lib/imaging/providers/google.ts:337 Identity is derived from the request body and honestly marked requested, but the routing layer lacks logical-model/member grouping and serving-side substitution detection.
lib/imaging/log.ts:132 Call logs and spend bookings record provider, model and outcome but omit policy version, deciding rule, call class and effort.
lib/imaging/log.ts:103 The log reports operational outcomes; no outcome-fed candidate quality estimator conflates those outcomes with semantic judgments.
lib/imaging/router.ts:142 The routing policy resolves to a static provider list rather than a decision carrying governing rules, with no edit-time validation of model overrides.
lib/imaging/router.ts:518 Vision requests assert only a capability; their contract has no required semantic call class mapped to a tier-and-effort pair.
